title: Impact across multiple GitHub products including Actions, Pages, and Copilot products.
excerpt: GitHub's Status Page - Impact across multiple GitHub products including Actions, Pages, and Copilot products..
content_html:
Resolved

This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 21:21 UTC

Update

The backlog of Actions jobs has been fully processed. We’re observing full recovery across all impacted services.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 21:21 UTC

Update

We’re seeing recovery across all services and continuing to monitor. The backlog of Actions jobs are being processed. We’ll update when we see full recovery.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 21:07 UTC

Monitoring

The degradation affecting Actions, Copilot, Pages and Webhooks has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 21:07 UTC

Update

Copilot is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:57 UTC

Update

We’re investigating issues impacting multiple GitHub products including Actions, Pages, and Copilot products.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:56 UTC

Update

Pages is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:56 UTC

Update

Webhooks is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:48 UTC

Update

Actions is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:48 UTC

Investigating

We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Pages

Posted Nov 11, 2026 - 20:48 UTC

This incident affected: Webhooks, Actions, Pages, and Copilot.
